method: Compare concatenated English text per label, ignoring layout and whitespace only
limitations: Changed text can be upstream/version noise, not necessarily Wishes story.
Unchanged expansion dialogue can still be used by Wishes and still needs translation.
Files missing from reference are listed separately, not classified.
This omits non-map, dynamic, C and unextracted text and cannot prove story completion.
Map depth is an over-approximation, not verified play order.
